title: Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on July 28, 2026
summary: LONDON, July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals International, plc (Nasdaq: KNSA) announced today that it will host a conference call and live webcast on Tuesday, July 28, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time to report its second quarter 2026 financial results and recent portfolio
